# Declaration

var x = 1;
void main() {}

==>

Program(Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",Literal(NumberLiteral),";")),Declaration(FunctionDeclaration(Type(TypeNoQuestion("void")),Identifier,"(",ParameterList,")",Block("{","}"))))

# Function

void main() {
}

==>

Program(Declaration(FunctionDeclaration(Type(TypeNoQuestion("void")),Identifier,"(",ParameterList,")",Block("{","}"))))

# Function Type

void f(int Function(String) callback) {}

==>

Program(Declaration(FunctionDeclaration(Type(TypeNoQuestion("void")),Identifier,"(",ParameterList(Parameter(Type(TypeNoQuestion(FunctionType(Type(TypeNoQuestion(TypeIdentifier(Identifier))),"Function","(",ParameterTypeList(ParameterType(Type(TypeNoQuestion(TypeIdentifier(Identifier))))),")"))),Identifier)),")",Block("{","}"))))
